title: Local-first operation
body: IDA_CLI-Public keeps discovery, status, inference, and public documentation explanations local. Network access occurs only for an explicit catalog refresh or model download.

title: Reviewed and experimental models
body: Reviewed models require an immutable Hub catalog revision and content hash. Public model downloads and inference accept safetensors weights only; legacy serialized weight files are rejected. Experimental public model IDs are opt-in, have no support guarantee, and never enable remote Python code.

title: Private boundary
body: Authority, private prompts, private corpora, training runtimes, workbooks, credentials, and deployment secrets stay outside the public CLI.
